study.question: Can the compact-evidence complement to timing_joint retain or improve its utility with a single small head, and does mixing the four source summaries before rectification improve over a matched additive head beyond duplicated-evidence capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed round25 limitation: merge_full AUC0.6312824319 versus timing_joint0.6306853561, but duplicate0.6311111670 recovers much of the difference; full minus compact is only0.0000031356. Compact minus duplicate is0.0001681292, full minus coarse0.0002270688, with a single-seed difference-in-differences0.0000589397. Full train868.59s/inference35.00s versus timing694.37s/26.31s, and coarse has slightly better logloss than full. These suggest small provisional fine-time utility, weak evidence for extra exchangeable transitions, and costly largely redundant additive heads. A small head that mixes histogram, conditional within-bin mean, local variance and third-moment magnitude before ReLU may capture interactions among these summaries more efficiently. The fixed orthogonal mixing changes cross-summary thresholds without extra learned parameters. This hypothesis remains untested; dominant histogram scale or lost per-head capacity may defeat it.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local method: same full timing parent and four summary definitions; replace its five appended heads (33424 parameters) with4256-parameter context-gated latent fusion, omit appended transition head, and consolidate repeated summary reductions. An efficiency comparison with round25 is a bundled architecture/execution comparison, not a single-mechanism contrast.

Both retain an extra chronological transition head and four separate residual heads; near tie of compact with full motivates removing that head. Our evidence replacements are repeated within the smaller architecture, with a second matched factor for conditional-head interactions.

Exact inherited architecture and constructor prefix retained, class renamed only; no extra events, IDs or labels. New logits equal this timing computation plus a zero-initialized residual at initialization.
Inherit empirical summary definitions, not a second copy of embeddings or its complete exchangeable-transition branch. Signed third-moment orientation is not tested or claimed here.

DIN uses ad-dependent event-level local activation and unnormalized weighted pooling. This study uses deterministic category/brand/action/time summaries and feature-level fixed mixing; no new DIN attention module or exact reproduction claim. The supplied baseline uses normalized softmax, an acknowledged adaptation. Priority/novelty beyond available sources remains unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Four independent bias-free64->8 projections yield[B,4,8] latent coordinates. Mixed mode applies the fixed H4/2 orthogonal transform along the four evidence blocks BEFORE ReLU; additive mode uses identity. Both get the same32-coordinate context gate and32->1 zero-initialized output. Independently replace the four distinct inputs with four copies of the ancestor histogram. All modes compute both latent alternatives and all empirical maps. One shared assignment/centering pass computes all maps; no extra appended transition head. The new factorial has4256 appended parameters in every cell, versus33424 in round25. Mixing changes cross-evidence function class at fixed context, not information or learned parameter count. No scientific priority claim.
predictions: The distinct compact inputs will improve AUC over duplicated histogram at matched head structure; report both mixed and additive evidence contrasts rather than selecting one after outcomes.

At fixed compact inputs, lean_mixed will outperform lean_additive if cross-summary thresholds help. Compare the analogous duplicate-input contrast and the predeclared difference-in-differences; a gain restricted to duplicates does not support compact-specific interaction.

A useful lean candidate beats both frozen source bests, especially timing_joint. Retaining merge_full AUC within0.0001 while reducing measured train/inference cost is a predeclared exploratory engineering target, not a formal noninferiority claim. Report logloss separately without changing selection metric.

Syntax/source checks predict unchanged inherited classes; host diagnostics predict source reproduction and direct-map oracle errors within2e-5, conserved counts, finite logits/maps, zero residual on zero input, H4 energy/inverse error within2e-5, zero separate latent-rectangle interaction and mixed latent-rectangle gap0.5. These are implementation predictions, not mechanism performance evidence.
falsifiers: No gain over timing_joint leaves incremental compact utility unsupported; gain equaled by duplicate inputs leaves evidence-specific utility unsupported.

Mixed compact fails to improve over additive compact, or the same mixing gain occurs with duplicated evidence: no compact-specific interaction support. Single seed improvements remain provisional until paired repetition.
Lower parameters without lower measured training or inference cost does not support an efficiency claim. A quality loss beyond the predeclared engineering margin weakens compression utility.

Nonfinite logits, incorrect map/support oracles, source reproduction failure, changed frozen inputs/loss/data, or counts inconsistent with declared support invalidates the affected contrast; retain charged failures rather than infer a scientific null.

trajectory_review: Reviewed static, pooled, DIN, compact-source, timing-source and all round25 factorial trajectories. All exposed receipts succeeded and previous_runtime_error is null; no absent failure history is invented. Shape source is weaker than timing. Extra capacity recovers much of the merge improvement, compact summaries add a small seed42 increment, added exchangeable transitions have near-zero effect at compact inputs and a negative effect at histogram inputs. Best AUC and best logloss differ. Earlier unexposed shape/control branches cannot be resolved as evidence. These are local observations, not repeated mechanism support. Latest knowledge usage was declared consideration of DIN/DMR, not causal confirmation of either source.
